name: Legged Locomotion Benchmark
description: Evaluates control approaches (MPC and RL) on legged robot locomotion tasks, measuring stability, speed, and energy efficiency.
reputation: Well-regarded within legged robotics and control research as a benchmark for comparing MPC and RL approaches, though adoption is more specialized than broad.
notes: Simulation- and hardware-dependent results can vary; non-LLM benchmark. Reproducibility can be affected by simulator choice and robot model; not saturated and primarily used in robotics/control communities.
